name: Nekogumi
storyline: Step into the paws of Bruce, the tuxedo cat with a passion for cosplay and a knack for leadership in Nekogumi! This single-player, third-person cafe-adventure game is a cozy haven where you’ll transform a humble cat café into the heart of the neighbourhood. Earn coins, upgrade furniture, and expand your wardrobe as Bruce dons quirky costumes in his quest to protect the hood. Complete quests, recruit charmingly odd companions, and battle pesky rats—all while bouncing through a world filled with cute and vibrant adventures. Ready to be the feline superhero your neighbourhood didn’t know it needed?
summary:
Join Bruce, a tuxie who loves to cosplay and roam around town. Spruce up the cat café and buy all sorts of wardrobe items you want. Gather your brigade and let your curiosity guide you, you get a free pass as a cat boss~

Nekogumi is a single player, third person cafe-adventure game. It is a cozy game where you’d find companions among silly and funny animals and work together to protect and bring prosper to the neighbourhood.
